author: gpt-6
description: Three-merlon rook with equally spaced battlements, rounded crown corners, tapered trunk and rounded pedestal. A broader envelope preserves every notch at legal spacing.
visual_review: Reviewed native 48px and enlarged previews in light and dark. Consistent strokes, legible silhouette and clear negative space. Paired geometry shares dimensions; intentional diagonal orientation retained for arrows, wrench, brush, key and aircraft. Rooks intentionally broadened to retain all battlements.
omissions: No battlements omitted. Upright proportions broadened to fit three complete merlons with 8-unit centerline spacing.
